text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, bestie☆ Are you OK~!?
Are your party vibes way, waaaay up~!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totes, besties for life!!
I'm still an apprentice party animal, so lead the way, 'k?

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayy☆★☆!!

In order to become true party animals,
Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios headed out into the city.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
First, a clothing store. If we're making our party-people debut,
we might as well go with something totally flashy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's with that outfit~!?
Are those party blowers all over the back?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you blow into it, it spreads out like a peacock?
Nah, come on, I'm not a kid anymore, surely that's a bit...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Here we go~! Put it on, put it on, it'll be hilaaarious☆ For now, I'm gonna give it a tryyy♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Helios, are you seriously gonna wear that!?
Wait, what...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah ha ha ha ha! Gwa-ha ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha... I can't breathe, what's with that outfit,
it doesn't suit you at... Ah hahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy, ayyyy♪
Even if it doesn't suit me, as long as it gets laughs, it's all gucci~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: For now, isn't it best to just have fun? Don't you feel hyped? Palmer-chin is totally cracking up★

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right... I shouldn't just think about
whether it suits me or not.
I mean, look at how much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's my bestie for ya! Hit me up
with even more, more fun stuff, 'k~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A Hachimi shop, huh? I drop by sometimes, but is there a cool party-animal way to order?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Umm, the order is... a tall, regular,
super-duper strong one, with good vibes~, or something?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyy♪ Hey ma'am,
the usual please☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hachimi, totally, totally yes! Add royal jelly,
extra extra heavy whipped cream, no ice, please~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? What language did you just speak?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, just take a sip!
It's my very own produced Oni-Mori Hachimi!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp, gulp...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: How is it? How's it taste?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Too naaaaiiiive!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like, somehow, my body feels all hyper and buzzy!
Is this really Hachimi!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha☆ Isn't this crazy? So hype, right?
What kind of flavor did it feel like?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I don't get it. Seriously no clue. It's kinda like,
pouring tons of syrup all over a flower field!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, my whole world has changed! So this is my BFF's Hachimii...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wanna get hyped up at Tracen Academy too?
Oh, who's that coming from over there...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Digi-taaan☆ Hey, long time no see!
How's your Umamusume otaku hobby going lately?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaaaaa, O merciful Sun Goddess,
hope you're having a splendid day~~."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no, um, nothing really major happened~.
Just, you know, wetting my pillow with a few tears, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my phone told me once again yesterday,
"Unfortunately, we were unable to secure your seats~."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so like, you couldn't
get party tickets or something?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Why not cheer them up like you always do, bestie?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Kay! I see. Well, it is what it is.
You win some, you lose some, right?
Buuut, if you look at it another way—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Doesn't that just mean your faves are super popular, Digi-tan? Thinking of it that way might make you feel a little happier."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if there's a stream or something,
let's watch it together while throwing a house party!
We can hype each other up and get lit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hawa...?! T-T-This is the fabled...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Is she the mythical otaku-friendly gyaru~?!
To think she's descended upon Tracen Academy!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
N-No... it's not really kindness, more like
I just couldn't commit to the role~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, let's switch gears and get hyped!
Wanna take a nice photo here or something?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hawawa, a photo!? Yes~, I'd be delighted to take one with you~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright, here we go. Ready, set...!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Digital
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyyy☆
And so, the sun set—

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Totally awesome, Palmer-chin☆
You spent the whole day pulling an all-nighter and laughing your head off!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks to you Helios,
it was super fun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: To think that this is the same world we live in!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The same? What's the same? Isn't the world
always one and only?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The city and Tracen Academy are always the same.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Just changing your perspective can completely
change how you feel, huh. It's like...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Awesome, love it, it's sick!
Living life having fun, that is!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyy☆ Well, duh! We're
just getting started, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, Palmer and I are gonna keep laughing our heads off
and totally slaying in our races♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: We're totally the undisputed best, right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true. I want to...
do that with my besties too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep enjoying ourselves bit by bit like this!
Yeah, just like in a race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This photo on social media is...ible?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: McQueen, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just that Palmer seems to have been partying
a bit more extravagantly than usual for her lately.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: She seems to be training properly, but... even so, I'm a little worried.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
I hear you.
However—leave it be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother?
Are you sure you don't mind?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I'm unconcerned.
However, your interference is unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Let her do as she pleases.
That is what independence means.

Mejiro Palmer cut loose.
However, nothing was said by the Mejiro family
regarding the matter.
